title: Shahad kabhi kharab kyun nahi hota?

captions.instagram:
Honey found in Egypt's thousands-of-years-old tombs still hadn't spoiled!

Egypt ki purani kabron mein mila shahad, hazaaron saal baad bhi kharab nahi hua 🍯

Kam paani + acid + hydrogen peroxide = super shelf life. Lekin dhakkan khula chhoda, to shahad kharab bhi ho sakta hai!

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine, Discover Magazine.
Photo: BotheredByBees / Flickr (CC BY 2.0).

Verses:
• Pots of honey thousands of years old, found in ancient Egyptian tombs, were still preserved — Smithsonian
• Honey has very little water, so microbes can't grow in it — Smithsonian; Discover
• Honey is acidic (pH about 3 to 4.5) — Smithsonian
• Bees add an enzyme (glucose oxidase) that produces hydrogen peroxide, which fights microbes — Smithsonian; Discover
• Left open in a humid place, honey absorbs moisture and can spoil; the seal matters — Smithsonian
